column1: 第16表農家平均每戶所得總額按來自農業與非農業分
Table 16. Farm Households Income from Agricultural and Non-agricultural
附註：一、農業所得係指農牧業淨收入、林業及漁業淨收入之合計。
二、本調查98年(含)以前，全年休(廢)耕者不視為農家。
三、自99年起，農家之定義配合農林漁牧業普查，將全年休(廢)耕者亦視為農家(B)。為利資料比較，
本表同時列示舊定義資料(A)。
Note：1.Agricultural income include agricultural、forestry、fishery and husbandry net income.
2.Before 2010, "farm household" means the household that plant crops on land.For 2010 figures of this old definition refer to (A).
3.From 2010, in accordance with the definition of Agricultural、Forestry、Fishery and Husbandry Census,
"farm household" include the households that hold arable land and leave the land fallow and uncultivated.For 2010 figures of this new definition refer to (B).
